label: TP
reason: User input from Referer header flows through URL decoding, then to doSomething() which returns bar, which is passed directly to response.getWriter().format(Locale.US, bar, obj). The format() method treats bar as a format string argument - if bar contains format specifiers (%s, %n, etc.), they will be interpreted by the formatter enabling XSS. The StringBuilder.replace() in doSomething() does not effectively sanitize format specifiers.

evidence.note: tainted header flows to format sink without effective neutralization
